testingApproach.body: Good test automation is architecture, not scripting. I map risk first: what breaks most, what costs most to miss. Then I pick the right layer — unit for logic, API for contracts, E2E only for paths that matter.
testingApproach.example: While testing a money-transfer flow in DailyFinance, a Playwright E2E test caught a race condition where the success toast appeared before the database write completed — meaning a retry would double-post. The fix was a server-side idempotency key. The test stayed to prevent regressions.
